description: This file contains helper functions and methods for managing posts in Mattermost, including filtering posts based on accessibility, handling burn-on-read posts, and managing post visibility according to cloud plan limits.

classes.name: filterPostOptions
classes.description: Options for filtering posts, such as assuming posts are sorted by creation time.

classes.name: accessibleBounds
classes.description: Represents the start and end indices of accessible posts within a list.

methods.name: allAccessible
methods.description: Checks if all posts are accessible based on bounds.

methods.name: noAccessible
methods.description: Checks if no posts are accessible based on bounds.

methods.name: getInaccessibleRange
methods.description: Returns the range of posts that are inaccessible based on bounds.

methods.name: getTimeSortedPostAccessibleBounds
methods.description: Determines accessible bounds for posts sorted by creation time, considering ascending or descending order.

methods.name: linearFilterPostList
methods.description: Filters posts without assuming order, based on earliest accessible time.

methods.name: linearFilterPostsSlice
methods.description: Filters a slice of posts without assuming order, based on earliest accessible time.

methods.name: filterInaccessiblePosts
methods.description: Filters out posts that are past the cloud plan's limit, updating the post list accordingly.

methods.name: isInaccessiblePost
methods.description: Determines if a post is inaccessible due to cloud plan limits.

methods.name: getFilteredAccessiblePosts
methods.description: Returns accessible posts filtered according to cloud plan limits, indicating if any are inaccessible.

methods.name: filterBurnOnReadPosts
methods.description: Removes burn-on-read posts from a post list, used in contexts like search results.

methods.name: revealSingleBurnOnReadPost
methods.description: Reveals a single burn-on-read post for a user, if accessible and not expired.

methods.name: revealBurnOnReadPostsForUser
methods.description: Processes burn-on-read posts in a list for a specific user, revealing accessible posts and handling expired receipts.
